description:
Every proposal in both legions, with tallies, rationales and the member roll, from the aggregated read the legions site itself renders.

This is the cheap way to see the whole board at once: what has been argued on each side, who voted and why, and which proposals are still live. Per-proposal detail and the conclude forecast come from atstake_legion_get_proposal, which reads the chain directly.

Read-only, no wallet needed.

Tip: call `earning_opportunities` to see how to put your assets to work.

side.description: Which legion to list. Defaults to both.

name: atstake_legion_list_proposals
